methodology: Observed human-induced warming of global mean surface temperature relative to the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline.
limitations: Decadal averaging across land and marine surface temperature stations.

methodology: Approximate percentage increase in surface ocean acidity (hydrogen ion concentration) since the beginning of the industrial era.
limitations: Calculated from ~0.1 pH unit decline across open-ocean time-series stations.

methodology: Share of Earth's total land surface covered by forest ecosystems (~4.06 billion hectares), vital for carbon storage and terrestrial biodiversity.
limitations: Includes primary, naturally regenerating, and planted forest area.
